headline: A device approval in one product line at a $50B company; no Edwards release found, stock flat

What changed: one more approved device in Edwards' transcatheter range. Tricuspid therapy is a small and early part of a $50.5B company's sales, and FDA reviews of such devices are public and expected.

objections: No primary source in our feeds; an expected product-line approval at a large company; no reaction.
